method.cost: No new parameters or convolution calls. Both new arms add a masked prefix mean, tanh, and residual addition; full candidate and control fit costs and conditional confirmation costs require host costing before execution.
method.mechanism: At the final block, compute the mean of valid strictly preceding final-block states. Candidate: add 0.1 times tanh of that mean to the current final-block state before the existing final LayerNorm. Generated control: retain the unmodified LayerNorm output, then add the identical saved signal immediately after LayerNorm and before the existing context readout. Both arms keep the incumbent dilation schedule and readout. This isolates injection location computationally; a ranking contrast alone cannot prove why it occurs.

tensor_constraints: Use only valid positions strictly before the current position; the signal is zero when no valid predecessor exists.

Keep block count, dilation order, embeddings, scoring, and all training helpers unchanged.
